witnesses.title: Duplicate delivery replays (side-effect count 1)

witnesses.title: Insensitive test cited as sole distinguisher collapses safety claim
witnesses.invariant: Inv6 (evidence must be able to fail)
witnesses.detail: sensitivityProbe marked base-pass/mutant-fail as sensitive and always-pass as insensitive; adjudicate blocked the insensitive case with BAD_TEST (BLOCKING) and approved the sensitive case.

witnesses.title: Ambient spawn (no broker intent) fails gate; direct spawn outside broker fails gate
witnesses.invariant: Inv2/Inv10 (nothing ambient survives; no rule counts until it executes)
witnesses.detail: Scanned 20 src/*.mjs files; 2 spawn hit(s) confined to allowlisted broker/queue files, 0 violations.

witnesses.title: AFFECTS without reachability proof never renders as REACHES
witnesses.invariant: Inv (schema §4: coordinates select, proof authorizes — AFFECTS != REACHES)
witnesses.detail: REACHES without evidence refused at write (REACHES_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED); AFFECTS listed only via affectedEntities, REACHES only via reachableEntities after proven-path evidence.
